coursework.en: AI permission depends on the course. The 2026 education policy asks programmes to specify permitted uses; example levels are not assigned permissions for every course.
coursework.zh: AI 使用许可取决于课程；2026 年教育政策要求明确允许用途，示例等级不代表每门课程已作相同授权。
coursework.meaningEn: Students must follow course-specific rules; level 3 AI-dominated output is not permitted for summative assessment in the policy’s example scale.
coursework.meaningZh: 学生须遵守课程专用规则；政策示例量表中第 3 级 AI 主导成果不得用于总结性考核。

exams.en: Programme and examination-board instructions determine the actual assessment restrictions; the general AI framework is not an exam-wide permission.
exams.zh: 具体考核限制须按项目和考试委员会说明确认；一般 AI 框架不构成全校考试许可。
exams.meaningEn: No programme-specific EER, complete exam restrictions or appeal clock is established here.
exams.meaningZh: 本次未核实具体项目 EER、完整考试限制或申诉起算规则。

disclosure.en: When AI use is permitted, disclosure is mandatory. Substantive use records the tool/version, purpose and contribution; interaction details are required where the course asks.
disclosure.zh: 获准使用 AI 时必须披露；实质性使用须记录工具及版本、用途与贡献程度，课程要求时另记录交互细节。
disclosure.meaningEn: 2026 education policy section 8; do not impose the old appendix template as a current universal format.
disclosure.meaningZh: 2026 年教育政策第 8 节；不将旧附录模板作为当前通用格式。

privacy_data.en: Do not enter personal, student, research or confidential data in public AI tools; assume inputs may be stored externally.
privacy_data.zh: 不得向公开 AI 工具输入个人、学生、研究或保密数据，并应假定输入可能存储于外部。
privacy_data.meaningEn: Public AI services; approved research environments require their own scope check.
privacy_data.meaningZh: 限公开 AI 服务；获批科研环境须另核适用范围。

approved_tools.en: UT’s portal lists standard Firefly features with monthly credits. Premium features or additional licence terms require contact with contract management.
approved_tools.zh: UT 门户列出附月度额度的 Firefly 标准功能；高级功能或额外许可条款须先联系合同管理。
approved_tools.meaningEn: Service-portal description; actual account entitlement, price and assessment permission were not tested.
approved_tools.meaningZh: 服务门户说明；未实测账户资格、费用或考核许可。

research_publication.en: Published research guidance calls for disclosure of substantial AI use and explicitly excludes teaching and AI-tool development from its scope. Its formal adoption status remains unverified.
research_publication.zh: 已发布的科研指引要求披露实质性 AI 使用，并明确不涵盖教学及 AI 工具开发；正式采纳状态仍待核实。
research_publication.meaningEn: Research-guidance scope only; do not substitute course disclosure rules or assert confirmed university-wide regulatory approval.
research_publication.meaningZh: 仅限科研指引，不套用课程披露规则，也不声称已确认全校规章批准。

academic_integrity.en: UT warns that AI-generated-text detection remains unreliable. An allegation and a detector output do not establish a finding; programme procedures still need checking.
academic_integrity.zh: UT 提醒 AI 文本检测仍不可靠；指控或检测输出不等于已认定违规，仍须查对应项目程序。
academic_integrity.meaningEn: Detection limitations and transparency; complete disciplinary outcomes and appeal periods were not established.
academic_integrity.meaningZh: 限检测局限与透明原则；未核实完整处分结果和申诉期限。

teaching_guidance.en: Teachers must clearly specify permitted AI use in assignments; students remain responsible for authenticity and course-specific compliance.
teaching_guidance.zh: 教师须在作业中明确允许的 AI 使用范围，学生仍对成果真实性及遵守课程规则负责。
teaching_guidance.meaningEn: 2026 education policy; programme-level implementation must be checked separately.
teaching_guidance.meaningZh: 2026 年教育政策；项目具体落实情况须另查。

security_procurement.en: Do not accept licences binding UT without prior approval, whether paid or free. AI applications must be reported through the AI Office.

security_procurement.meaningEn: Institutional licence and compliance governance, not personal assessment permission.
security_procurement.meaningZh: 机构许可与合规治理范围，不代表个人考核许可。
